text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is drawing to a close,<n>and the
students are getting ready to<n>head back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer. Do you see the<n>expressions on their
faces?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Ryan! Once we get back,<n>let's hit the
track!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you think I'm the same racer I was<n>before
camp, you've got another<n>thing coming! You're
going down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who's going down!<n>I've been
itching to run since I got<n>outta bed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How much stronger have I gotten?!<n>How much
better of a racer am I?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My pecs are crying out... They've<n>gotta know!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They have a little more pep in their<n>step, wouldn't
you say? And it's all<n>because they can feel how
much<n>they've improved.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Summer training has a way of<n>bringing the best
out of our students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have no doubt they will all make<n>marvelous
debuts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And if my planning has contributed to<n>their future
success in some way, I<n>will be more than
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly think I am so weak as to<n>falter at this
hurdle?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no trace of the loss of<n>composure that I
saw a few days<n>ago.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean to ask if I feel I've<n>improved over
the course of the<n>camp?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But of course. And now I'm ready to<n>sally forth.
My charge will be<n>unstoppable.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so this year's summer camp<n>comes to an
end.
